goal: FG-327: remove dead code and retired shard machinery

components.summary: Defines function blocks, workflows, traces and reports.
responsibilities: define function blocks, workflows and traces
compose a sequence of blocks or a choice of blocks by accepted input type

components.summary: Collects exact pytest ids, runs bounded parallel shards and reports each test's outcome.
responsibilities: shard tests by exact node id and run every shard on each invocation
verify each collected test ran exactly once in the release whole-suite phase
side_effects: runs pytest shards; writes run-local cache

components.summary: Generates ordinary behaviour, validator and UI journey models plus adoption rules.
responsibilities: generate behaviour, validator and ui-journey starters plus six adoption rules
make placeholder code and test anchors fail until the user fills them

remove: responsibility:describe model and test outcomes in generated notes
responsibility:report typed capability blockers and bounded process cleanup results
